page.overview:
Who is Ace Azzameen?

Ace Azzameen was a male individual who was a member of the Azzameen family. He was the youngest son of Tomaas Azzameen, and owned a droid named MK-09. After the deaths of Tomaas and one of Ace's siblings, Galin, Ace took possession of the family's YT-2000 Otana, and traveled to the Anoat Sector with his siblings to seek refuge among the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
